svg.aria-label: The full stack: router · replicas · shared pools · DRAM PC
svg.text: The full stack: router · replicas · shared pools · DRAM PC
mirror copies of saved prefixes → PC store (red); router lists the store and can pull from it to any replica
Clients talk only to the router (OpenAI-compatible API). The router picks the replica by queue + prefix hit + link speed.
Replicas = more servers of the same model. Split = one model over several cards/machines. Both can be on at once.
